title: Amazon seemingly leaked Jason Statham’s entire Mutiny movie
summary: Jason Statham's Mutiny film is currently available to stream in full on Prime Video US, two days before its theatrical release on August 21st, suggesting an unintentional leak. The 95-minute movie being prematurely accessible could significantly impact the film's box office performance.
content:
This screenshot shows the Mutiny (2026) page listing on Prime Video US, and the “resume” bar indicating that it’s watchable. | Image: Amazon / Dominic Preston / The Verge	

Jason Statham's upcoming film Mutiny is set to hit theaters on August 21st, but it can already be streamed in full on the US version of Amazon's Prime Video service. My colleague Dominic Preston was able to verify that all 1 hour and 35 minutes of the movie is available to watch on Amazon's streaming platform, despite the Mutiny website and marketing materials stating that it'll only be available in theaters when it's officially released in two days.
There's nothing to suggest that this was released on Prime Video intentionally, or that it's intended to be some marketing stunt - neither the Punch Palace Productions and MadRiver Pictures pro …

zh.title: 亚马逊似乎泄露了杰森·斯坦森的整部《叛变》电影
zh.summary: 杰森·斯坦森的《叛变》电影目前可在美国Prime Video上全集流播，比影院上映日期（8月21日）提前两天，暗示这是一次无意的泄露。这部95分钟的电影过早上线可能会对电影的票房表现产生重大影响。

title: AI isn’t close to curing cancer. This startup says it knows what it will take.
summary: A startup argues that while AI alone cannot cure cancer, the critical barrier to breakthroughs is access to quality data and research infrastructure. The company believes properly structured datasets, rather than advanced algorithms, are the key limiting factor in AI-driven cancer research.

zh.title: 人工智能离治愈癌症还很远。这家初创公司说它知道需要什么
zh.summary: 一家初创公司主张，虽然人工智能单独无法治愈癌症，但突破的关键障碍是获得高质量数据和研究基础设施。该公司认为，结构良好的数据集而非先进算法，是人工智能驱动的癌症研究中的关键限制因素。

title: You can Venmo your college tuition, for some reason
summary: Venmo now allows users to pay college tuition through its platform, expanding payment app functionality into higher education costs. The addition demonstrates how fintech services have become integrated into traditionally formal institutional payment processes.
content: Kids these days don't know how good they have it.

zh.title: 你可以用Venmo支付大学学费，不知为何
zh.summary: Venmo现在允许用户通过其平台支付大学学费，扩展了支付应用程序在高等教育成本中的功能。这一增加展示了金融科技服务如何已融入传统正式的机构付款流程。

title: Nvidia’s new financial strategy does not compute
summary: Nvidia is partnering with major financial firms including BlackRock, Goldman Sachs, and KKR on a $500 billion financing initiative to position computing chips as an investable asset class. CEO Jensen Huang argues compute is now a revenue-generating, productive asset worthy of institutional investment.
content:
“Compute is an asset class! Compute is an asset class!” I continue to insist as I slowly shrink down and turn into a corncob | Image: Cath Virginia / The Verge, Getty Images	

April - 1805
Napoleon is master of Europe
Only the British fleet stands before him
Compute is now an asset class
I see it is once again time to talk financial innovation. Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs, and KKR are all working with Nvidia to put together $500 billion in financing to turn compute into an asset class.
"This is really the first time that technology chips have become an investable asset class," Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said to CNBC. "These are revenue-generating assets now. They're productive, they're long-lived, they're fungible, they're flexible."

zh.title: 英伟达的新金融战略行不通
zh.summary: 英伟达正在与黑石、高盛和 KKR 等主要金融公司合作开展一项 5000 亿美元融资计划，旨在将计算芯片定位为一种可投资资产类别。首席执行官黄仁勋认为，计算现在是一项能产生收入、具有生产力的资产，值得机构投资。

title: The women’s soccer league trying to fix fantasy sports
summary: The Women's Super League launched an official fantasy sports game featuring prominent player photography to improve fan retention throughout the season. The new game targets fantasy sports' common engagement problems while aiming to attract and retain fans of growing women's soccer.
content:
The WSL’s first official fantasy game is putting player photos front and center, which is less common than you might expect. | Image: WSL Football	

Most fantasy sports leagues suffer the same problem: retention. Leagues play out over monthslong seasons, require regular attention, and can punish players severely for missing even a single week. I've started Fantasy Premier League (FPL) multiple times, but never finished a season. 
That's a problem for any fantasy league, but especially so for a new game in a growing sport, hoping to attract new fans who might grow along with it. And so when Manchester United take on London City Lionesses on the opening day of the Women's Super League (WSL) season next month, fans will have a chance to compete in a fantasy league that's a little different …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.summary: 女子超级足球联赛推出了官方梦幻体育游戏，采用突出球员摄影来改善整个赛季的球迷留存。新游戏针对梦幻体育常见的参与度问题，同时旨在吸引和保留不断增长的女子足球迷。

title: Amazon’s drones will soon deliver to nearly 500 US cities and towns
summary: Amazon's Prime Air drone delivery service will expand to nearly 500 US cities and towns by year-end, a six-fold increase from current coverage, with new launches in Chicago, Syracuse, Cleveland, Atlanta, and Boise. Each location serves approximately 175 square miles.
content:
Prime Air is launching in Georgia, Ohio, Illinois, Idaho, and New York soon. | Image: Joseph Ciembroniewicz/Omaha World-Herald via Getty Images	

Amazon says its drone delivery service will reach "nearly 500 cities and towns in the United States" by the end of this year, increasing its coverage by six times compared to the current footprint. Prime Air deliveries will soon be launched in the Chicago, Illinois; Syracuse, New York; Cleveland, Ohio; Atlanta, Georgia; and Boise, Idaho metro areas, according to Amazon's announcement, with "more communities to come later this year."
These will join 11 locations across the US where Amazon already offers drone deliveries, with each Prime Air site serving an area of approximately 175 square miles. The service aims to quickly deliver packages o …

zh.summary: 亚马逊 Prime Air 无人机送货服务将在年底前扩展到美国近 500 个城市和城镇，相比目前的覆盖范围增加了六倍，在芝加哥、锡拉库扎、克利夫兰、亚特兰大和博伊西开设新服务点。每个地点覆盖约 175 平方英里。

title: The everyday tech I use to track my corgi
summary: An Apple AirTag attached to a pet's collar provides tracking security similar to tracking keys or luggage, serving as insurance against unexpected loss. While unnecessary for loyal herding dogs, the device offers peace-of-mind protection.
content:
The Apple AirTag may be a jack-of-all-trades - people use it for keeping track of keys, suitcases, backpacks, purses - but I think the most logical use case for it, by far, is keeping track of your pet. I attach it to my corgi Jelly's collar via a matching silicone holder. Have I ever once truly needed it to find her, and do I think she'd ever run off on me? No - she's a pretty loyal herding dog, so she likes to keep an eye on her parents - but just like whatever else you may attach an AirTag to, there's a significant chance that the one time you truly need it, you'll be thanking God that you had it. (Kind of like insurance.)

zh.title: 我用来追踪我柯基的日常科技
zh.summary: 附在宠物项圈上的苹果AirTag提供了类似于追踪钥匙或行李的追踪安全性，可作为防止意外丢失的保险。虽然对忠诚的牧羊犬不必要，但该设备提供了安心的保护。

title: Framework gave its 12-inch laptop some hardware upgrades
summary: Framework released a second-generation 12-inch convertible laptop with Intel's latest Core Series 3 processors, expanded customization options, and a Linux Fedora pre-load option, starting at $699. Pre-orders are available with deliveries expected in October.
content:
Framework launched a second-generation of its colorful 2-in-1 convertible laptop. | Image: Framework	

Framework has refreshed its 12-inch convertible laptop, introducing Intel's latest Core Series 3 processors, expanded hardware customizations, and a pre-built Linux option. The cheapest pre-built base configuration for the Framework Laptop 12 now starts at $699 - $100 less than the previous version when it launched last year. Preorders are open now, with the first wave of deliveries expected to ship in October.

title: Relativity Networks raises $22 million to bring a faster kind of fiber to data centers
summary: Relativity Networks raised $22 million in funding to deploy hollow-core fiber technology in data centers, enabling data transmission 30% faster than conventional fiber. The rarely-deployed technology addresses critical latency and speed requirements in modern infrastructure.
content: Relativity Networks deals in hollow-core fiber, a rarely deployed technology that allows data to be transmitted 30% faster than conventional fiber.

zh.title: Relativity Networks募集2200万美元为数据中心引进更快的光纤
zh.summary: Relativity Networks募集了2200万美元资金，以在数据中心部署空心光纤技术，使数据传输比传统光纤快30%。这种很少部署的技术解决了现代基础设施中关键的延迟和速度要求。
